rationale: A local improvement without an end-to-end change does not locate the binding delay. The same observation can reflect offsetting increases elsewhere or an aggregate improvement too small to distinguish from variation, while the changed handoff remains the principal delay. Framing the inference as suggestive and operating-point-specific does not establish the proposed location.
signal_basis: - Absence of response: no distinguishable change at a stage or in end-to-end turnaround.
